mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100k signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k/month, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% in a given month, it indicates a tight labor market that precedes stronger corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy responding to inflation, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's regression coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1450 thousand units signals rebounding consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-pandemic recovery when HOUST > 1450, or the return difference from baseline is not significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1.0% signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% month-over-month, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units in a given month, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's regression coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
